title: Wording and test-robustness LOWs from the WCLI-139 review (none blocking)
description: Follow-ups from the Opus APPROVE at ced8e77 of ward-cli#264 (WCLI-139). (1) errors.ts comment above binding_changed says the checkout "is still registered as far as this refusal knows", which is false on the vanish arm; say the set changed under it, so project_not_registered would mislead. (2) ADR 0022 clause 2 and the unregister.ts comment near the in-transaction check should say "no binding when the command starts" (or "when it was asked"), since project_not_registered is pre-question only. (3) binding_changed sits under the Secrets section comment, which says none of them claims that nothing was changed, while its message says Ward removed nothing: move the entry or amend the comment. (4) test/unregister.test.ts uses profileApprovals.slice(1) in the changed-approval race, which depends on approval order; filter by identity.root instead.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The four wording and test-robustness items above are corrected
lore check and bun run check stay green

implementationNotes: Implemented on fix/WCLI-143-review-lows. (1) errors.ts binding_changed comment now says the registration changed or was withdrawn under the command, and names project_not_registered as the no-binding-at-start code. (2) ADR 0022 clause 2 and the unregister.ts in-transaction comment say no binding at the start / when the command starts. (3) Amended the Secrets section comment to except binding_changed, whose message can say Ward removed nothing; entry not moved. (4) the changed-approval race filters profileApprovals by identity.root instead of slice(1); still asserts binding_changed. ADR wording compacted because the implementation lore profile sits at its budget (0022 added ~22 tokens over; fixed by wording, not max_tokens). bun run check 1222 pass; lore check, lore validate --strict and check-lore-agent-sources green.
